scope: Union of all six sample PDFs in the current county-clerk-linked 2026 General Election folder; one additional folder member is the election notice.
sourceCaveats: All six currently listed sample PDFs were obtained as original PDF file bytes and extracted locally. The state-only sample has no local questions; 001-1 has the two county questions; the four other styles have those two plus school Issue 4A.

The complete authenticated folder listing returned seven direct children below the 100-item limit. This establishes the observed published-folder denominator, not a guarantee against an unlisted separate notice.

The official county HTML was obtained as a deterministic reader HTML capture. Government-origin HTTP status was not observed. Original PDF bytes were delivered through the Google Drive connector; its HTTP 200 describes authenticated artifact delivery.
limits: Current published Kiowa folder inventory only; not statewide local completeness.
